params.caption: 🖥️ Elon Musk signs petition to bring Jensen Huang back as Nvidia CEO An online petition calling for the former Nvidia CEO to be reinstated has passed 130,000 signatures, and Elon Musk has added his name. Not everyone inside Nvidia is on board, though: Tom's Hardware reports that some employees do not support Huang's return. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 15:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 🤔 React 👍 or 👎 · 💬 Should Nvidia bring Jensen back? #Nvidia #JensenHuang #GPU #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
